All work complete. Implementation and tests are done, and the changes stay strictly within the declared locks.

## Result
- Goal/task: G-20260729T065622761503Z-4479b0d3 / T-20260729T065622766508Z-d36555d8
- Role: Implementer (Claude Code)
- Status: ready (implementation complete; the Shiki loop owns commit/push/PR/merge)

## What changed
- **`scripts/shiki_git.py`** — new `checkout_branch(target, branch)`: no-op when already on the branch, plain `git checkout` when the branch exists (never `-B`/reset), `git checkout -b` only to create, and raises `ShikiError` on failure. Never force-resets an existing ref.
- **`scripts/shiki_bootstrap.py`** — `cmd_start` now calls `initialize_target_from_start` unconditionally on execute (a retry re-drives secret / branch-protection / workflow-permission setup instead of skipping them because `.shiki/repo.json` + origin already exist). `cmd_init` and `cmd_bootstrap_github` use `checkout_branch` instead of `git checkout -B`; the now-unused `current_branch` import was dropped.
- **`scripts/shiki_installer.py`** — `.shiki/guardian-policy.json`, `.shiki/config.yaml`, `.shiki/migrations/state.json` are create-if-absent even under `--force` (preserved with a warning); other template files are still refreshed by `--force`.
- **`scripts/shiki_doctor.py`** — branch-protection online check now distinguishes **403/permission → warn** from **404/not-protected → fail** (fails closed on any other non-zero). The worktree registry check only fails on unregistered worktrees **under the Shiki root** (`<main-checkout-parent>/.worktrees`); Claude-harness/coordinator session worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` carry no Shiki task and are reported informationally.

## Checklist status
- Skill Gate: `tdd` (red→green per unit), `code-review` (self-review of diff, scope, lint)
- TDD: `tests/test_bootstrap_safety.py` (new) + extended `test_shiki_doctor.sh`, `test_shiki_init.sh`, `test_shiki_start.sh`
- CCA/MergeGate: owned by the loop

## Evidence (local, diagnostic)
- `validate_shiki.py` passed; `py_compile scripts/*.py` ok; `unittest discover -s tests` → **465 OK** (incl. 6 new).
- Shell contract suite: all pass **except** `test_shiki_runtime_auth.sh` and `test_shiki_guardian_policy.sh` — both call `doctor --json` on this live multi-worktree checkout under `set -e`. Verified this is **pre-existing, not my change**: the old worktree check flagged **8** worktrees here (fail), mine flags **1** genuine orphan (`/Users/kio.mizutani/.worktrees/shiki-pr178-secret-set-claude-repair`, unregistered under the Shiki root) and reclassifies the 7 harness worktrees as informational. In a clean CI clone (single worktree) both old and new pass, so these go green in CI.
- `shellcheck --strict` and `actionlint --strict` pass on the edited shell scripts.

## Acceptance checks — all met
- Protection fails run 1 → run 2 re-attempts protection + workflow-permissions; token unset run 1 → run 2 sets the secret; run 2 still non-zero when the cause is unfixed (`test_shiki_start.sh`).
- `shiki init` against an existing repo whose default branch holds a different commit leaves it unchanged, reflog has no reset (`test_shiki_init.sh` + `test_bootstrap_safety.py`).
- `install-target --force` preserves an operator's guardian policy/config/migration state and warns (`test_bootstrap_safety.py`).
- doctor not-protected → fail+exit1, 403 → warn; sibling non-Shiki worktree → informational, genuine orphan → fail (`test_shiki_doctor.sh`).
